# Version 4.156.0 (Unreleased)
> **Allocation and lifetime improvements**

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.156.0 reduces allocations in pixel and text-processing paths while fixing front-buffered stream retention. Managed pixel copies and HarfBuzz text operations avoid temporary allocations without changing their results. Disposed front-buffered streams now release borrowed source streams.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Managed pixel copies allocate less** — Valid managed pixel buffers now copy directly into raster images instead of first creating an intermediate SKData instance, while invalid-input behavior remains unchanged. ([#5052](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5052))
- **HarfBuzz text operations avoid temporary buffers** — UTF-32 buffer input and feature-string formatting now reuse or stack-allocate their encoding buffers while preserving existing HarfBuzz results. ([#5060](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5060), [#5230](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5230))
- **Disposed front-buffered streams release borrowed streams** — SKFrontBufferedManagedStream no longer retains an underlying stream after disposal when it does not own that stream. ([#5327](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5327))
